description: Counts and totals of FRA-reported US railroad accidents or grade crossing incidents, grouped by railroad, cause, accident type, state, year or road user. Returns per-group incident count, killed, injured and (for train accidents) damage cost. Use for "which railroads had the most derailments in 2023", "top causes of train accidents in Texas", "crossing deaths per year since 2015", "rail accident trend by year".

dataset.description: "accidents" = rail equipment accidents (Form 54, default); "crossings" = highway-rail grade crossing incidents (Form 57).

from_year.description: Restrict to this year and later (use with group_by "year" for a trend).

group_by.description: Grouping. "cause" and "accident_type" apply to accidents; "highway_user" to crossings; the rest to both.

railroad.description: Restrict to one railroad (reporting-mark code or name substring).

state.description: Restrict to one US state (code or name).

name: rail_accident_summary
title: Rail Accident Summary
